name: vault-slack-scan
summary: Deep scan Slack channels, DMs, and threads for a person or project and turn the evidence into vault-ready context.
done_when: workflow scope is satisfied or explicitly blocked
external evidence is labeled with source and retrieval status
touched files are listed with paths
verification: verify changed Markdown/frontmatter where files were edited
verify wikilinks where notes were created or changed
verify external evidence is labeled and scoped
